regions.finding: Current-work generic tandem Au-catalyzed cyclization/oxidative arene coupling; graphical abstract duplicates the generic scheme rather than a concrete experiment.

regions.region: two-column introduction and lower-right optimization lead-in
regions.finding: Background/cited chemistry was not imported as current work; prose supplies Table 1 entry 1 outcome context and identifies 1a, 2a, and 3a.

unresolved: Graphical abstract does not report concrete charges, time, or an individual yield.

regions.finding: Scheme 1A is scaffold/application context; Scheme 1B-a, 1B-b, and 1C are three cited-work generic examples; Scheme 1D is the current generic scheme.

All 15 optimization rows were extracted separately, including catalyst substitutions, AgSbF6, oxidants/loadings, concentration, 2-equiv arene exception, no-Au control, and 1 mmol scale-up. All three numeric columns are target-linked; 1a is recovery and 2a/3a are product yields.
Prose cross-checks Table 1 outcomes and introduces Scheme 2; no additional concrete reaction beyond the table rows was manufactured.

unresolved: Supporting Information with further optimization was not supplied.
Main-text Table 1 does not supply workup, purification, or characterization operations.

regions.finding: Nine beta-ketoallene scope displays were checked. Product 2a (87%, 3 h) duplicates Table 1 entry 12 and was merged; products 2b-2i yield eight independent scope records.

regions.region: Scheme 2 lower red box, products 2j-2ac and footnotes
regions.finding: All 20 arene/indole scope products were inventoried with displayed yields and times; 2m retains footnote-b AuCl3 10 mol% while the remaining scope entries retain 5 mol%.
Five concrete mechanistic/control studies were extracted: Au(I)+PIDA coupling, 3a negative control, arene chlorination control, D2O labeling, and paired parallel H/D KIE study.
Author-proposed routes A/B retained as proposed_mechanism, not as an observed experiment.

unresolved: Scheme 2 yield measurement bases are not stated in the main-text footnote.
Dense Scheme 2 structures and exact positional isomers were not forced into guessed SMILES.
KIE analytical/rate-fitting details and D-incorporation methods are unavailable without SI.

regions.finding: Confirms 5 at 77%, 3a-d1 from deuterodeauration, kH/kD=1.0, and the authors' interpretation that arene C-H functionalization is not rate determining.

regions.region: left-column proposed catalytic cycles and conclusion
regions.finding: Mechanistic prose supports the proposed-mechanism record; route B is suggested as major but route A is not ruled out. No proposed intermediate was promoted to an observed product.
The paper states that SI exists, but the workspace contains no explicitly associated SI file; association remains unestablished.
